scene.sousTitre: guides you through every step: analysing your idea, setting up your company in France, building your plan, and moving forward with confidence. Management tools are there when you need them. So are the best tools on the market.

reassurance.decisions: You stay in charge of your decisions

analyser.texte: IGINI studies your idea: what holds up, what gets stuck, what to do next.

creer.texte: In France: legal form, articles, filing. You submit it yourself, guided step by step.

construire.texte: Milestones, budget, funding sources: a plan you follow task by task.

avancer.texte: Simple tools to get started, specialised tools as you grow, and IGINI to help you decide.

analyse.texte: A summary, a feasibility score out of 10 that says why, the strengths, the risks and the next steps.

creation.nom: Set up your company in France
creation.texte: A recommended legal form, a draft of your articles to be reviewed by a professional, and your file for France's one-stop shop. You submit it: Ignitux never files or pays anything for you.

plan.texte: Build plan, funding plan, an assessment reviewed by Ignitux. Its suggestions become tasks you track, never carried out for you.

memoire.texte: IGINI remembers your decisions and preferences, and links the ideas of your project together.

apercu.legende: Example — a made-up project, to show what an analysis looks like
apercu.resume: A real need in a very bike-friendly city; profitability depends on the price of a service and on the season.
apercu.etape1: Test the price of a service with 20 cyclists

idee.texte: And you want to know whether it holds up before putting your time and money into it.

creation.texte: In France: legal form, articles and incorporation file, step by step with IGINI.

entreprise.texte: IGINI helps you shape what comes next: funding, growth, and choosing the right tools.

inclus.texte: Quotes and invoices, bookkeeping, manually entered banking, till, stock, calendar: enough to get started without installing anything.
inclus.limite: They don't replace a specialised tool or your accountant.

specialises.intro: You keep the best of each; IGINI helps you know which one to use, and when.

liste.pennylane: Your accounting and invoices, connected with your accountant.
liste.qonto: An online business account, with the capital deposit when you incorporate.
liste.shine: An online business account designed for freelancers and small businesses.

outils.independance: No commercial agreement: Ignitux earns nothing if you choose one of these tools. These are examples, not a closed list.

prix.intro: No subscription: you only pay for the IGINI actions you run.

outils.creation: Company setup: legal form, articles, filing

igini.bienvenue: {n} credits offered when you sign up
igini.affiche: The price is shown before you start; nothing is charged if IGINI fails

prix.paiement: Top-ups of €{a}, €{b} or €{c} — card payment coming soon.

transparence.decisions: IGINI suggests, you decide: nothing is carried out or filed on your behalf.
transparence.europe: Your database is hosted in the European Union (Ireland); some technical providers are in the United States, and the policy names each of them.
transparence.vente: Your data is never sold, nor used for advertising or to train an AI.
transparence.export: From your account page, you download everything — including the images of your ID document — and delete your account whenever you want.
transparence.ia: When you use IGINI, Anthropic (United States), which provides its AI, receives the content of your project needed for the answer.

gratuit.r: The basic tools are: projects, company setup, team and simple management tools, with no subscription. Only IGINI actions are paid, in credits (1 credit = €{valeur}); {n} credits are offered when you sign up.

outils.q: Does Ignitux replace my accounting software and my bank?
outils.r: No, and that's not its goal. Its simple tools are enough to get started; after that, accounting software, a business account and your accountant do better. IGINI helps you choose.

creation.q: Does Ignitux set up my company for me?
creation.r: No. Ignitux prepares your file and explains the filing step by step; you submit it yourself on France's one-stop shop (guichet unique). Ignitux never files or pays anything for you.

statuts.r: Not as they are. IGINI writes an AI-generated draft: have it reviewed by a professional (lawyer, chartered accountant) before using it.

telephone.q: Does it work on a phone?
telephone.r: Yes. Ignitux opens in your browser and installs like an app, on Android, iPhone and Windows.

accueil.pret: Ready to bring your idea to life?

rencontre.texte: What if you were no longer alone?

construction.texte: IGINI analyses, guides and supports every step.

reussite.texte: An idea becomes a project. A project becomes reality.

avenir.texte: Every spark counts. For a world of possibilities.
